pages.visible_text:
CLI
Skill
Github
1
Install the CLI
One line — auth, uploads, and polling are handled for you.

npm install -g @higgsfield/cli
2
Sign in
Opens a browser, takes 5 seconds. Run higgsfield auth login and you're authenticated.

higgsfield auth login
3
Plug skills into your agent
Works with Claude Code, Cursor, Codex, and 12+ other agents. Then just say: "Generate an image with Higgsfield."

npx skills add higgsfield-ai/skills
